task.title: Pin the typed unknown-sender rejection regression
task.description: Strengthen the unknown-sender inbound regression so it pins the explicit CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED trust guard instead of accepting any throw (review finding F-012), and prove by bounded mutation that deleting the guard now fails the suite.
task.scope: apps/cli inbound tests only. No implementation changes unless the strengthened assertion exposes a real code gap, which must be reported rather than silently fixed.

acceptance_criteria: F-012 (minor): the unknown-sender fixture test asserts the public rejection code CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED specifically, not a generic rejects.toThrow.
The same test still asserts that persisted state is unchanged and that no acknowledgement is sent for the rejected envelope.
The changed-device case and the malformed-ciphertext case remain distinct tests, each asserting its own intended typed failure, so one guard cannot mask another.

Bounded mutation evidence: with the dedicated missing-contact guard removed, the inbound suite now FAILS on the CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED assertion (previously it stayed green). The mutation is reverted afterwards and no canonical source file is left modified.
The full CLI test suite and the workspace suite are green with the strengthened test in place.

Carried from the completed T33 fix (finding T33-I1): remove the test-harness build race. apps/cli/src/commands/cli.test.ts runs `pnpm run build` while apps/cli/test/e2e/two-process.test.ts runs `pnpm --filter @echolet/cli build`, so two suites rebuild the same apps/cli/dist/cli.js concurrently while both spawn it; one observed run failed with `CLI send exit (INVALID_ARGUMENTS): expected 2 to be 4`. Build the CLI binary exactly once before any suite spawns it (for example a vitest globalSetup, or a single build step the suites depend on) so no suite rebuilds a binary another suite is executing. This is a harness fix, not a product change - do not alter CLI behaviour or the exit-code contract to achieve it.

Anti-flake evidence: after the harness fix, `pnpm --filter @echolet/cli test` passes on three consecutive independent invocations, with the two-process E2E green in each. Report the three results explicitly; T37 depends on this being trustworthy.
